'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Sibille Schöntauf LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Sibille Schöntauf]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck title LSC. Sheet Scutorr/Scyhtorrr → [[Sai'torr Kal Fas (V)]]. Sheet Obi-Wan's Lightsaber (EPI) → [[Obi-Wan's Lightsaber]].


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Sibille Schöntauf]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|We'll Handle This]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
